Let me analyze the last question and the client's response to it.

The counselor says: "제가 자리를 옮겨도 되는지 물었을 때의 대답과, 나중에 그때 실제로 어땠는지 다시 물었을 때의 대답을 나눠보려고 해요."
(The counselor wants to separate the response when asked about moving the chair from the response when asked later what actually happened.)

The client says: "그때 괜찮다고 해놓고 나중에는 조금 불편했다고 했었죠."
(At that time I said it was fine, but later I said it was actually a bit uncomfortable.)

The counselor then says: "맞아요. 처음 그렇게 답한 마음과 나중에 정정해서 말한 마음을 각각 확인해볼까요?"
(Right. Shall we check each of the feelings - the one when you first answered that way and the one when you later corrected yourself?)

So the counselor is asking about two specific moments:
1. When the client first said "괜찮아요" (It's fine) - when the counselor asked if they could move the chair closer
2. When the client later said "괜찮다고 했지만 조금 불편했어요" (I said it was fine but it was actually a bit uncomfortable) - when the counselor asked what actually happened

Looking at the private turns:
- Turn 12: "괜찮아요." - This is when the counselor asked "의자를 가까이 옮겨도 괜찮을까요?" and the client said "괜찮아요." The inner appraisal shows the client felt uncomfortable but said it was fine because they didn't want to seem difficult.
- Turn 24: "괜찮다고 했지만 조금 불편했어요." - This is when the counselor asked "지난번 의자가 가까웠을 때 실제로는 어땠나요?" and the client corrected themselves.

The last question asks to confirm both of these moments - the initial "괜찮아요" response (turn 12) and the later correction "괜찮다고 했지만 조금 불편했어요" (turn 24).

So I need to select turns 12 and 24.
